name: gmpulse
description: GMPulse — personal IPO tracking command center

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n server,client "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
